proof_body:
by
  intro n r
  have h1 : Nat.card {P : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ // ∑ i, P i = r} = Nat.card (Sym (Fin (n + 1)) r) := Nat.card_congr (Sym.equivNatSumOfFintype (Fin (n + 1)) r).symm
  have h2 : Nat.card (Sym (Fin (n + 1)) r) = (n + r).choose r := by
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Sym.card_sym_eq_choose, Fintype.card_fin]
    congr 1
    omega
  rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
  change Nat.card {P : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ // ∑ i, P i = r} = _
  rw [h1, h2]
  exact (Nat.choose_symm_add).symm
target_source: ∀ n r : ℕ, Set.ncard {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ | ∑ i, x i = r} = (n + r).choose n
